title: Opportunities and Challenges of Large Language Models for Low-Resource Languages in Humanities Research

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating performance disparities between high-resource and low-resource languages, dialects, and ancient scripts using stratified benchmark metrics (e.g., TLUE, AmericasNLI, AraDiCE) and analyzing model failures in code-switching and dialect-specific contexts.

Assessing models' comprehension of cultural metaphors, specific religious concepts, and polysemy across contexts, and reviewing debate-induced evaluations to identify the projection of dominant cultural perspectives onto minority traditions.
